teaser: Agent sessions with a mandate, a role and a repository, paused and picked up again, so a team's knowledge outlives the team.
core_idea: When project teams dissolve, the knowledge needed to change their systems leaves with them; agent sessions focused on one mandate, role and repository can be paused and resumed with their record intact, as two PHP-team sessions did after 28 hours, so a later fix can wake the team rather than rebuild its knowledge.

figures.caption: When the team leaves, and when it can be woken: the usual life of a project team, where people move on and the knowledge goes with them, against a team of agent sessions, each with one mandate, role and repository, paused at no cost and picked up again with its history intact.

Two sessions on the PHP story's team, paused and picked up again: the librarian's last commit on 22 October at 20:20 UTC and its next on 24 October at 00:12; the cartographer's last on 22 October at 19:48 and its next on 24 October at 00:16. Each resumed by taking in what the rest of the team had done.
